message:
You know, there's something satisfying about being prepared for anything life throws our way. I stumbled upon a great resource that lays out how to create a family emergency plan, and I can't help but feel a bit smug. I’ve always believed that knowing what to do in an unexpected situation can ease a bit of the chaos. 

It’s just practical — like having a map in uncharted territory. After all, a little planning can go a long way. Have you thought about your own plan lately?
